description: Scored retrieval eval set for HookahLedger. Each query is scored precision@5 - 1 if any expected_lounge appears in top-5 retrieved, else 0. Queries are run with rerank, without rerank, and (when aspect_filter is set) with the aspect filter as well. The aspect_filter pass tests whether the system's built-in filtering rescues queries that struggle as bare semantic queries. Negative-evidence and thin-evidence queries are NOT in this file - they live as qualitative demo flows.

queries.rationale: Laika 123 positive flavour, Globe 59. Bare query is hard because dense retrieval finds reviews that mention flavour, not lounges with the most positive flavour reviews. The aspect_filter pass tests whether explicit filtering rescues the query.
Banc 379, Tigerbay 329, Noya 267 positive service. Top three in North London.
Noya 201 positive food (pan-Asian + shisha), Banc 154. North London food anchors.
Edgware Road Lebanese/Iraqi food anchors per inspect_data.

Top three by atmosphere_vibe positive count: Noya 146, Basrah 123, Shisha Garden 101. The Banc was in the v2 expected list but its atmosphere count is below these three; corrected per inspect_data output. Bare query is fuzzy; aspect filter pass tests whether explicit filtering improves precision.

Drunch is the positive premium-Mayfair option; Mamounia is also premium Mayfair but value-negative. Drunch must be reachable in top 5. No aspect filter - the query is about overall premium experience, not a single aspect.
Maps to coal_management positive without saying it. Globe and Laika tied at 23 positive coal each. Aspect filter tests whether the system can perform the implicit-aspect inference.

queries.query: lounge that doesn't run out of smoke
queries.rationale: Same coal_management target, different paraphrase. Tests retrieval robustness to vibes-language.

queries.query: somewhere I won't be embarrassed bringing a date
queries.rationale: Maps to atmosphere_vibe + seating + premium. Wide expected list because date-night is genuinely fuzzy. Mamounia included for atmosphere (positive) despite value being negative.

queries.query: best mid-tier shisha under 25 with good food in north london
queries.rationale: Both Banc and Shisha Garden Edgware are mid-tier North London. Banc has stronger food signal (154 positive vs Shisha Garden's 64). Either is a defensible top-5 surface.
